title: NavLogLeg

power_pct.description: The power flown; null where the profile names no cruise power (no power model: its TAS and burn as given at every altitude, no other airplane's power assumed).

climb_fuel_unknown.description: True on a leg with climb minutes where the profile gives no climb fuel flow: the climb's gallons are not counted in its fuel, for the app to ask for the figure (no multiple of the cruise burn is assumed).

phase.description: The one phase a leg is flown in whole, where it is the climb or the descent, its figures then that phase's (with_climbs, with_descents): the app words its workings by it. Left out for a leg in the cruise or cut by a top of climb or descent, whose pieces are each one phase.

start_at.description: A pilot's Start At at the fix the leg starts from (wingtip.own_altitude): a descent to the leg's lower altitude begins at that fix and runs on from it at three to one, rather than being done by it (navlog_with_descents).

description: A nav log leg (PHAK ch. 16's dead reckoning); null time, ground speed and fuel is an unflyable leg. Members the log does not know (procedure, hold, airway) are carried through.
